summary.text: Jacob Bossman is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 14 and has served in the Iowa House since 2017.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's biography for the 89th General Assembly (2021) lists Bossman as a regional director for U.S. Sen. Chuck Grassley, with a B.S. in economics from Morningside College.
It says Bossman was born in 1980 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and lives in the Morningside area of Sioux City.
